_how: What the uptime check watches, and what 'up' means for each kind. product = a page a customer lands on: must be 200 HTML with a title. service = a worker/API: must answer, and if it exposes a health endpoint the tick must be fresh. redirect = anything 2xx/3xx.

checks.name: STPi service root
checks.note: Root answered a bare JSON 404 until 2026-11-10. Once the entry page is deployed this becomes 200 HTML and the check stops warning.

checks.name: STPi health
checks.note: ok must be true and the last tick must be under 120 minutes old.

checks.name: STPi owner console
checks.note: 401 is correct here: the console is closed until you authenticate.

checks.name: DeskOS (old host)
checks.note: The 404 at this root is why the venture URL was moved to deskos.deskos.workers.dev. Kept here so the old host is not silently forgotten.

checks.name: Operatorship
checks.note: First edition, 2026-11-10. A readable edition that stops answering is a dead link on the catalogue.

checks.name: Ops site (sealed)
checks.note: Ciphertext, but it must answer 200 — a phone that cannot load it is the whole point lost.
